learning_outcomes.text: The student will be able to build, program and run his or her own robotic product and use 3D printing for that end.
The student will have verified the knowledge in practical situations.

syllabus_topics: hands-on workshops with LEGO Spike Prime
practical building and programming of robot models
practical workshops with other robotic platforms – Jupiter, Nico, Mikeš

assessment_methods.method: active participation at seminars and/or events

assessment_rules: Grading is based on active participation. The grading scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%.
bibliography: Petrovic P. (2020) Spike up Prime Interest in Physics, Robotics in Education 2020.
Alan G. Smith: Introduction to Arduino. A piece of cake! IntroToArduino.com, 2011.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
